correctness.rationale: PASS: For m-1 iid uniform order statistics the m gaps are Dirichlet(1,...,1). Conditioning on k specified gaps exceeding t leaves a scaled simplex; computing conditional sum of squares gives k t^2+2kt(1-kt)/m+2(1-kt)^2/(m+1). Inclusion-exclusion proves F_m and A_m at all thresholds, including breakpoints. Layer-cake beta integration and harmonic binomial sums yield E[MG] and covariance B_m/[m(m+1)(m+2)], with B_m-B_{m-1}=2(H_m-1)/m>0. Exact Dirichlet fourth moments yield Pearson correlation and asymptotic sqrt(6)/(2pi)*(log m)^2/sqrt m. Independent exact rational checks m=2..34 and a separate m=2 threshold integral supplement, not replace, the all-m proof.

value.rationale: PASS: The maximum spacing and Greenwood quadratic gap sum are two classical, naturally compared goodness-of-fit statistics. Their exact conditional first quadratic moment and positive finite-m covariance, together with asymptotically vanishing correlation, resolve a motivated dependence question and provide directly usable finite-sample calibration. No independence or testing-power theorem is asserted.
